# ESP-IDF Installation Manager (EIM)

Documentation: https://docs.espressif.com/projects/idf-im-ui/en/latest/
Troubleshooting: https://docs.espressif.com/projects/idf-im-ui/en/latest/troubleshooting.html
Scripts and CI: https://docs.espressif.com/projects/idf-im-ui/en/latest/scripts_ci_and_agents.html

A failure names an EIM-E number. Open that section of the troubleshooting page.
Installing a path that is already installed finishes successfully and does not reinstall it.
CLI log: <data dir>/eim/logs/eim.log. GUI log: eim_gui.log. Offline builder log: offline_installer.log.
Linux and macOS do not install prerequisites for you. Windows can, with --install-all-prerequisites true.
Do not unpack an offline .zst archive. Pass it to --use-local-archive.
